stories.title: Tedavi için Türkiye'ye geldiler, pansiyonda yan yana ölü bulundular

en.title: They came to Turkey for treatment, found dead side by side in a guest house
en.summary: Two elderly expatriates who arrived in Pamukkale, Denizli for thermal therapy were discovered dead together in their guest house accommodation.

en.title: Fund protest in Eskişehir: Those who caused the crisis must pay the price
en.summary: Citizens gathered in Eskişehir to protest a fund investigation, demanding accountability from those responsible for economic hardship and expressing concerns about poverty and unemployment.

stories.title: 4 bin lira sermayeyle başladığı işte milyoner oldu

en.title: Started business with 4 thousand lira, became a millionaire
en.summary: A former waiter who left her job and invested approximately 4,900 Turkish lira in starting a kitchen business went on to achieve millionaire status.

stories.title: Ümit Milli Takım'ın play-off rakibi Çekya oldu

en.title: Czech Republic determined as play-off opponent for Turkey U-21 team
en.summary: Turkey's under-21 national football team was drawn to face Czech Republic in the European Championship play-off round.

stories.title: 131 fonun tasfiyesi için kanun teklifini Meclis'e sunulacak

en.title: Bill on liquidation of 131 funds to be submitted to parliament
en.summary: The ruling party plans to submit legislation to parliament regarding the liquidation of 131 investment funds that have been designated for closure.

en.title: Artist Feyzan Alasya meets visitors at 'PENDULUM' exhibition
en.summary: Artist Feyzan Alasya's ninth solo exhibition titled "PENDULUM" explores human search for balance and center amid contrasts through surreal visual language.

stories.title: Mal paylaşımı davasının görüleceği gün eski eşini öldürdü

en.title: Man kills ex-spouse on day of property division trial
en.summary: A man in İzmit killed his ex-wife, the mother of his child, on the day their property division case was scheduled to be heard in court.

stories.title: Mal paylaşımı davasının görüleceği gün eski eşini öldürdü! Görgü tanığı dehşeti anlattı: 'Abi yapma' diye yalvardım

en.title: Man kills ex-spouse on day of property division trial; witness describes horror
en.summary: A man fatally shot his ex-wife with a gun near her workplace on the day their property disputes were to be heard, with a witness attempting to intervene.

stories.title: İzmir’de kaçak sigara fabrikasına operasyon: 125 milyon TL’lik ürün ele geçirildi!

en.title: Operation against illegal cigarette factory in Izmir: 125 million TL worth of products seized
en.summary: Turkish authorities conducted an operation against an illegal tobacco and tobacco product manufacturing facility in Izmir's Kemalpaşa district, seizing machinery and contraband goods valued at approximately 125 million TL. One suspect was detained and an investigation was launched.

stories.title: 'Arap Emrah' suç örgütüne operasyon! Çok sayıda gözaltı var

en.title: 'Arab Emrah' criminal organization operation! Multiple detentions
en.summary: Law enforcement conducted simultaneous operations against an organized crime network led by 'Arab Emrah' operating across multiple provinces. Multiple suspects were detained as part of the coordinated action.

stories.title: İzmir'de dev kaçak tütün baskını: 125,4 milyon TL'lik malzeme ele geçirildi

en.title: Major illegal tobacco raid in Izmir: 125.4 million TL worth of materials seized
en.summary: Turkish customs and smuggling prevention teams conducted an operation against an illegal tobacco manufacturing facility in Kemalpaşa, seizing machinery and equipment valued at 125.4 million TL. One suspect was detained in connection with the operation.

stories.title: 'Arap Emrah' suç örgütüne darbe: 8 ilde eş zamanlı operasyonda 34 gözaltı

en.title: Blow against 'Arab Emrah' criminal gang: 34 detained in simultaneous operations across 8 provinces
en.summary: Authorities conducted simultaneous operations against an armed criminal organization led by 'Arab Emrah' based in Istanbul, resulting in 34 suspects being detained. Firearms and money were recovered from searched addresses.

stories.title: Zengin Z kuşağının parası buraya gidiyor: Diğer kuşakları ikiye katladılar

en.title: Where wealthy Gen Z's money is going: They've doubled other generations
en.summary: Wealthy young people are changing their spending habits, with Gen Z significantly outpacing other generations in the art market according to a UBS and Art Basel study across 10 countries, including in high-value million-dollar purchases.

stories.title: Yandex’in veri merkezlerine İHA saldırısı: Hizmetlerde aksama yaşanıyor

en.title: Drone attacks on Yandex data centers: Service disruptions occurring
en.summary: Russian tech company Yandex reported service disruptions after drone attacks damaged data centers in Ryazan and Kaluga regions, with the Ryazan facility completely halted and no timeline given for infrastructure restoration.

stories.title: Halkbank ürün ve hizmetleri artık ChatGPT’de

en.title: Halkbank products and services now available on ChatGPT
en.summary: Halkbank integrated its products and services into ChatGPT, allowing users to connect their Halkbank accounts and access information about credit cards, auto loans and other offerings through natural conversation.

stories.title: AB'den Çin'e karşı 21 milyar euroluk hammadde hamlesi

en.title: EU's 21 billion euro raw materials move against China
en.summary: The European Union selected 46 strategic projects across 16 countries worth approximately 21.1 billion euros to reduce dependence on Chinese raw materials, focusing on lithium, copper and rare earth elements to mitigate supply risks.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs'tan çarpıcı petrol analizi: Risk primi 2022'deki zirveyi aştı

en.title: Goldman Sachs' striking oil analysis: Risk premium exceeded 2022 peak
en.summary: Goldman Sachs reports that Brent crude's risk premium reached its second-highest monthly level in September, driven by Middle East supply concerns, investor hedging demand, and declining inventory levels.
